description: scripts/check_self_explaining.py exits 0 with a 'skipped' notice when git merge-base HEAD origin/main finds nothing (NO_MERGE_BASE_NOTICE), so a shallow or fetch-limited CI checkout passes every change unchecked. It also prints only a total, so the per-file effect of the gate is not measured. In the default (non-staged) mode a missing merge base must fail the check; a shallow checkout must be deepened first (fetch origin main, then unshallow) and the check fails when that does not yield a merge base. Staged mode (--staged) keeps comparing the index with HEAD and needs no merge base. The result also reports, per changed file, how many added docstrings and comments were found, and the total.
goal: Make the self-explaining check fail closed and report counts per file. Default mode: when no merge base with origin/main can be found, try to obtain one (a shallow repository is deepened by fetching origin main and unshallowing), and if there is still none, print a clear error on stderr and exit non-zero instead of skipping; remove the skip notice and its exit-0 path. --staged mode is unchanged. On every run print, per file with violations, a line with the path and the number of added docstrings/comments, then the total; on success print the number of changed files checked. Keep the existing violation message lines. Replace the test that expects a skip with tests that prove the failure. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: A gate that passes when it cannot see the change measures nothing. Failing closed and reporting counts per file makes the rule enforceable and its effect visible.
acceptance_criteria: A test in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_check_self_explaining.py proves that running scripts/check_self_explaining.py in default mode in a repository with no merge base with origin/main exits non-zero and writes an error naming origin/main to stderr; the NO_MERGE_BASE_NOTICE skip path no longer exists.
A test proves a shallow repository without origin/main history is deepened by the merge-base lookup in scripts/self_explaining_diff.py (or the check fails when it cannot be), never skipped.
A test proves the output reports, per file, the count of added docstrings/comments and the total, and that --staged mode still passes without a merge base.
All tests pass via 'uv run pytest', and 'uv run task lint' passes.
